items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was, I thought, better than Bing Crosby, but his life got cut short.

ctx.x: When did you start listening to him? When did you recognize him?

I recognized him before anybody, because he was singing, and I was always interested in that. I also liked Russ Columbo. Russ Columbo was very handsome. Italian extraction, I think he was. He got killed in Los Angeles. He was a very handsome guy, good singer. He was, I thought, better than Bing Crosby, but his life got cut short.
What made you want to sing to emulate him?
